notes: A one-song concert with a performer, a raised stage and a crowd facing it is Entertainment's venue-stage and the Performance Venue preset - the genre note about the crowd facing one way is the whole design here, since every recording is shot toward the stage. Kept social-hub for the club floor and spawn-first-reveal for the composed opening view, added vignette-photo because the game exists to produce shareable captures and zone-graphics for the dramatic coloured lighting rigs, and added npc-population for the small ambient crowd the answers asked for; dropped the preset's spectator-bleachers because a compact club floor is flat and raked tiers would add elevation nobody described. This stays walkable rather than SET: the player's chosen avatar performs in the venue rather than orbiting it as a diorama, and it was a close call given how much of the loop is camera work. Decided without a user: build the default compact indoor club, which is entirely interior so there is no exterior transition and no P3, and treat the 3 stages by 3 environments as interchangeable variants of that single layout - generating all nine as separate maps would be P4, which is not ready, so the combination matrix is recorded here rather than routed.
